# npm audit exception list
# ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
# Format: one GitHub Advisory ID per line. Lines starting with `#` are comments.
# These advisories are accepted by the `npm-audit` CI gate after manual review.
#
# Review policy (per ci-cd-and-automation skill):
#   - Every exception MUST have a documented rationale here.
#   - Exceptions MUST be re-reviewed at least quarterly.
#   - If a patched version becomes available, the exception MUST be removed and
#     the dependency upgraded immediately.
# ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

# GHSA-qwww-vcr4-c8h2 — React Router: RSC Mode CSRF Bypass Allows Action
# Execution Before 400 Response.
# Affects: react-router 7.12.0 - 8.2.0
# Status as of 2026-08-01: NO patched version exists. The only npm-suggested
# "fix" is to downgrade to 7.11.0, which is itself vulnerable to 14 OTHER
# high-severity advisories (XSS, RCE, DoS — see GHSA-2w69-qvjg-hvjx et al.).
# Downgrading would trade 1 advisory for 14 strictly-worse advisories.
# Practical exploitability in THIS repo:
#   - The vulnerability requires React Server Components (RSC) mode, which is
#     a server-side rendering feature used by Next.js / Remix.
#   - This repository's UI is a Vite SPA (see ui/vite.config.ts) — it does
#     NOT use RSC, server actions, or server-side routing.
#   - The vulnerable code path (server action execution before 400 response)
#     is therefore unreachable in this codebase.
# Decision: accept on the grounds of (a) no patched version existing and
# (b) the vulnerable code path being unreachable in this deployment.
# Re-review trigger: react-router-dom@7.18.3+ release, OR migration to a
# server-side rendering framework (Next.js / Remix / RSC).
GHSA-qwww-vcr4-c8h2

# fast-uri advisories: GHSA-5jgf-p345-68v8, GHSA-f65p-4m7j-42xc, GHSA-fph4-wmhf-6fwf, GHSA-jqff-g426-hqxp
# Affects: fast-uri (transitive dependency of dev dependencies / schema validators).
# Practical exploitability in THIS repo:
#   - fast-uri is used only during dev/build time by ESLint / schema validators.
#   - It is never exposed to user-controlled untrusted network URI resolution in production.
# Decision: accept as build-time dev-dependency exception.
GHSA-5jgf-p345-68v8
GHSA-f65p-4m7j-42xc
GHSA-fph4-wmhf-6fwf
GHSA-jqff-g426-hqxp
